title: Hack The Box Meetup #15

organizer.name: Hack The Box Meetup: Melbourne, FL, US

description:
📣 Registration is open for Hack The Box Meetup #15! 🎉

We’re excited to announce the next Melbourne Hack The Box Meetup!  
📃 Register here: [https://www.meetup.com/hack-the-box-meetup-melbourne-fl-us/](https://www.meetup.com/hack-the-box-meetup-melbourne-fl-us/)  
🗓 Date: Wednesday, September 23rd  
🕓 Time: 6:30PM Eastern. We will wrap at 8:30PM Eastern.  
📍 Where: EFSC, Palm Bay. Building 3, Cyber Lab

Whether you're experienced or not, you’re welcome to join us! We will work on one or more pathways on the HTB platform. Beginners are welcome! Again, no experience necessary, just bring your curiosity.

🛑 IMPORTANT:  
To attend, you must register on the Hack the Box Melbourne, FL Meetup:  
👉 [https://www.meetup.com/hack-the-box-meetup-melbourne-fl-us/](https://www.meetup.com/hack-the-box-meetup-melbourne-fl-us/)

📌 RSVPs on [Meetup.com](http://Meetup.com) are how Hack The Box measures the success of our community, so please help us out by signing up as soon as it’s published!

💡 It’s fine to use a fake name or throwaway email for [Meetup.com,](http://Meetup.com,) but when registering for the event, you’ll be asked for the real email address you use with Hack The Box.

Let's show Hack The Box that we can bring out a huge crowd.

Hope to see all of you soon! 🚀
